style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent warm thermal-wear ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white #FFFFFF, warm sand #E8DCC8, deep charcoal #26262E and one flame-orange accent #E8702A, with deep ember red #B5231F reserved for heat-tech infographic panels; warm directional studio lighting with front-left key, soft fill and soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif bold condensed headlines in #26262E on light grounds or #FFFFFF on dark panels; consistent thin-line circular outline icons in #E8702A; clean high-end apparel photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; garment presented as ghost-mannequin or on a generic non-identifiable model with the face never visible, clean margins around the garment; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no visible model faces.
noDrift: no literal fire photos covering the garment
style.presentationRules: garment presented as ghost-mannequin or worn by a generic non-identifiable model, stable front 3/4 hero angle, consistent garment scale across the set, model face never visible
